discovery_notes: Top-up of packet 105 (reuses its keys). 30 WebSearch calls, all claims from snippets; dein-dlrp monthly pages are previews so dates are planned. Planned Mar 2020 LEs after 13 Mar were delayed: Maleficent spring released 12 Sep 2020, Pocahontas carousel 19/26 Sep 2020. Conflicts: Jul 2021 carousel/Best Friends LEs also appear in a Dec 2020 feed snippet; Big Thunder 2021 OE vs LE 700; Halloween trio location; Alice Aug 2021 LE 400 vs 700. Gaps: Nov 2020, Jan-Apr 2021 (closure), Jun 2021, Nov 2021 detail, hotel pins. No instructional content seen.
